verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical and both are broken. The quote is jammed into the top of the red panel above a large empty red area. A stray rule line strikes through 'MODERN'. The attribution sits off to the side instead of under the quote. The skyline has shrunk to a small strip inside a separate white box, so it no longer anchors the design, and the frame lines are scattered. B only moves things a few pixels to the right, which doesn't change any of these problems.
